desire.text: a bridge over the ford, so that it never takes anybody else

prayers.title: for a bridge over the ford
prayers.selfTitle: for a bridge over the ford
prayers.text:
It's Tam. Again. Sorry.

I am asking for a bridge over the ford, so that it never takes anybody else.

If you can't, that's alright, I'll figure something.

desire.text: word from my daughter Wren, whether she is alive and whether she is well

prayers.title: for word from his daughter Wren
prayers.selfTitle: for word from my daughter Wren
prayers.text:
I said I would not come back here.

I am asking for word from my daughter Wren, whether she is alive and whether she is well.

That is all. I have work.

desire.text: somebody my own age, or a dog, or anything that wants to be near me

prayers.title: for someone to be near
prayers.text:
It's Tam. Again. Sorry.

This is the real one, the one underneath the others: somebody my own age, or a dog, or anything that wants to be near me.

Anyway. That is the thing I wanted.

desire.text: to know who my family were, and what the name Fenn was before it was mine

prayers.title: to know where she came from
prayers.selfTitle: to know where I came from
prayers.text:
I have thought about how to ask this properly.

This is the real one, the one underneath the others: to know who my family were, and what the name Fenn was before it was mine.

I remembered this on the way here: Ledger, page one: "Things I do not know." It is the longest page.

I will write down whether you answer. I write down everything.

desire.text: books, or anyone at all in this village who can read what I write

prayers.title: for books, and someone who can read them
prayers.selfTitle: for books, and someone who can read them
prayers.text:
I have thought about how to ask this properly.

I am asking for books, or anyone at all in this village who can read what I write.

I remembered this on the way here: Ledger, page one: "Things I do not know." It is the longest page.

Thank you. Whether or not.

desire.text: a plough that holds together for one whole season

prayers.title: for a plough that holds together
prayers.selfTitle: for a plough that holds together
prayers.text:
I am not good at this.

What I want is a plough that holds together for one whole season. I have wanted it long enough that it has stopped feeling like wanting.

I remembered this on the way here: The winter fever. The sound the house made afterwards, which was nothing.

Neth would have asked nicer. I am asking how I ask.
